Blocks.Text: The Internal Talent Management API returns a member’s LinkedIn profile at the direction of that member and subject to the member’s privacy settings. This private API is only available to support an organization’s internal talent initiatives, and use is restricted to current employees.
Note
The use of this API is restricted to those developers approved by LinkedIn and subject to applicable data restrictions in their agreements.

You must use an access token with r_fullprofile scope to make an authenticated call on behalf of a user. Please refer to OAuth 2.0 Authentication Code Flow to learn more about how to retrieve an access token with required scope.
Note

You may only store data returned from the Profile API for the authenticated members with their permission. Please refer to this document for guidance on storing authenticated member data. You may never store data returned from the Profile API for members other than the authenticated member.
To identify and retrieve the current member's profile based on the access token, call below endpoint.

http


curl

GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/me
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

curl --location --request GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/v2/me' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'
A successful request will return 200 OK HTTP status.
To know more about the fields returned in the response, refer here - Full Profile Fields.

The urn returned in the id object is the unique identifier of the member. This should be stored and referenced where possible as LinkedIn APIs utilize both URNs and IDs. In our API documentation, we reference this urn as Person ID.
Note
Each Person ID is unique to the context of your application only. Sharing a Person ID across applications will not work and result in a 404 error.
The vanityName is used to represent the public profile URL in the following format: https://www.linkedin.com/in/{vanityName}.

Blocks.Section: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
SectionPath: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
Blocks.Text: When you call an API, the response may contain organization URNs referencing the organization data as stored by LinkedIn. These URNs are valuable on their own; however, there may be instances when you want to expand a URN and access the values associated with the entity.

Blocks.Section: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
SectionPath: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
Blocks.Text: Additional organization data can be added the API response by altering the request URL with projection strings as shown in the example. To know more about response projections refer here.

Blocks.Section: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
SectionPath: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
Blocks.Text:
http


curl

Blocks.Section: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
SectionPath: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
Blocks.Text:
GET https://api.linkedin.com/v2/me?projection=(positions*(company~,*),educations*(school~,*),*)
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Blocks.Section: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
SectionPath: Retrieving additional organization data with response projections
Blocks.Text:
curl --location --request GET 'https://api.linkedin.com/v2/me?projection=(positions*(company~,*),educations*(school~,*),*)' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer <access_token>' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json'

Blocks.Text: To ensure the Internal Talent Management API behaves as expected and adheres to the agreed upon Internal Talent Management API terms, LinkedIn must certify the finished development of your integration of this API into your application before it is released to your current employees. Upon completing development, please reach out to your Business Development point of contact to schedule a certification call.
